prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a MUCH more carefully crafted semi-realistic game character art reference for an indie psychological horror game. Input 1 is the identity and clothing reference: ordinary Korean male night caretaker, age 27, lean-average build, 176cm, short slightly untidy black hair, charcoal zip work jacket over a gray tee, dark straight trousers, worn gray sneakers. Input 2 shows the REJECTED low-quality model: use it only to understand the problems to fix, do not mimic its puffy shapeless clothing, pale doll skin, melted facial details, crude hair or featureless hands.
One single full-body character, front-facing A-pose with arms 30 degrees away from torso, relaxed straight fingers spaced apart, feet apart, entire head and soles visible. Centered on plain warm-gray background.
QUALITY DIRECTION: finished professional realtime game character sculpt with carefully defined eyelids, eye sockets, nose cartilage, lips, jaw and ears, natural subtle facial asymmetry and slightly tired adult expression. Clearly articulated knuckles, tendons, fingernails and finger joints. Dark hair built from layered tapered sculpted locks with fine directional definition, a convincing hairline and varied silhouette. Anatomically convincing shoulder, elbow, pelvis and knee structure. Jacket must have real garment construction: visible collar thickness, zipper, stitched seams, pocket openings, cuff ribs, hem, layered shirt edge, plausible tension folds at elbows and waist, cloth drapes over a lean body rather than inflated tubes. Trouser seams, natural fabric breaks at knees and ankles, properly shaped shoes with clear sole tread and laces.
MATERIAL DIRECTION: polished restrained semi-realistic 3D game art; lifelike warm skin color with gentle color variation but restrained pores, modest roughness variation, convincing matte woven cotton, slightly worn edges, soft natural hair sheen. Visible sophistication at medium viewing distance, crisp distinct shapes. This should look like a professionally authored 3D character, not a photograph or a faceted low-poly toy. Keep natural adult proportions, no anime face, no oversized eyes, no exaggerated muscles, no plastic shine, no bland all-gray clay material, no overly pale face. Soft balanced neutral studio illumination preserves material colors and readable details without dramatic overexposure. High resolution, full-body portrait composition. No extra portraits or panels, no text, no badge, no watch, no flashlight, no weapons, no background props.

Use case: style-transfer. Convert this photograph-like character reference into a polished SEMI-STYLIZED 3D GAME CHARACTER showcase. Preserve the exact Korean adult identity, realistic body proportions, outfit construction, pockets, zippers, articulated hands and facial anatomy. The single required change is art direction: eliminate the photographic surface rendering. Clearly visible crafted 3D sculpt, softly simplified painted skin, elegant clean transitions of cheek and jaw, carefully sculpted eyelids and lips, layered sculpted hair locks rather than thin flyaway strands; high-quality stylized PBR cloth with clean seams and selective carefully shaped folds. Keep the refined geometry and rich form definition; do NOT turn this into low-poly art, angular polygon planes, an inflated mannequin or blurry mobile-game model. Restrained stylization with smaller realistic eyes, natural nose, tired ordinary adult face, subtle warm skin and no pore/freckle noise. The goal is a sophisticated PC game character, between a realistic character and a tasteful stylized character, visibly computer rendered rather than a photo. Keep charcoal zip jacket, gray tee, dark trousers, worn gray sneakers; replace shoe logo with a plain side panel. Single full-body front view in relaxed A-pose, arms 30 degrees away from body, no extra figures or closeups. Light warm-gray studio background with soft neutral lighting, polished model turntable render aesthetic, no text. Retain all joints, garment layers and clean individual fingers.
next_model_direction: Prioritize facial/hand forms and garment layers in source geometry; optimize after evaluating actual model. Do not infer final mesh quality from this generated reference image.
